newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska cattle sales thin at $110/dressed-private.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska cattle sales thin at $110/dressed-private.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle markets near midday Friday were slow, with light reported sales of $108.00-$110.00 per cwt on a dressed basis, steady with Thursday, market sources said.
About 1,000 head sold Friday morning, including a few on a live basis at $67.00, steady with Thursday's top paid late in the day. Weekly sales were estimated at 27,000, sources said.
Cattle remaining on this week's showlist, which had been projected at 70,000 head, were being offered at $110.00 to $112.00 on a dressed basis and $67.00 to $68.00 on a live basis, sources said.
